resources.string: Open HMG-Seogaemo with the steering-wheel user button.

While enabled, Open HMG-Seogaemo replaces the current steering-wheel user-button assignment (for example, gohome). HMG-Seogaemo reapplies this assignment after restarts and overrides choices made in stock button settings while enabled. Turn this module off to choose another function. Disabling restores the exact original assignment, replacing any intervening choice. This action does not appear in the stock button settings list.
